title: Guillermo Rauch:  Why we built NextJS - CEO of Vercel
description:
NextJS is the most popular React framework. In this clip from my two hour interview with Guillermo Rauch, we discuss why he created NextJS and why choosing React first is the best choice. Guillermo is the CEO of Vercel and co-creator of NextJS. 

To see the entire interview with Guillermo you can check it out here on YouTube:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=6iLBhnWRrxo&t=4582s

Or listen on your favourite podcast app:
https://anchor.fm/work-in-programming/episodes/Guillermo-Rauch--NextJS-9-4--JAMStack--distributed-systems--and-manging-eventually-consistent-state-ee1gaf
